periods.label: NFL Kickoff
channel_actions: Raise CTV, Linear TV, YouTube and Paid Search around kickoff week.
Use state-safe copy variants before localising offers.
Hold CRM/app pushes for game-day reminders rather than broad prospecting.
inventory_notes: Prime video and football inventory should be reserved before final creative locks.
Expect CPM pressure in football windows.
governance_notes: Professional football moment; state product eligibility still applies.
periods.one_off_brief: Plan an incremental NFL kickoff-week awareness burst for Sportsbook in selected live states, with state-safe copy and CTV/YouTube/Paid Search focus.
periods.insight: The first football week is the cleanest reach-and-intent moment in the calendar.

periods.label: Super Bowl
channel_actions: Use national TV/CTV/YouTube for reach and Paid Search for capture.
Separate pre-kick campaign claims from in-game ad claims.
Keep affiliate and promo language in legal review.
inventory_notes: Premium inventory and creative approvals need early lock dates.
Use fallback digital video if TV cost inflation clears the guardrail.
governance_notes: Professional football moment; responsible-gambling copy review remains mandatory.
periods.one_off_brief: Draft a Super Bowl lead-in one-off plan for Sportsbook with national reach, CTV/Linear TV/YouTube emphasis and Paid Search capture.
periods.insight: The Super Bowl is the sharpest national heat spike; use it for attention, not unsupported conversion certainty.

periods.label: March Madness
channel_actions: Use search/social intent capture where college-market rules clear.
Shift restricted states toward generic brand or non-college messages.
inventory_notes: Bracket and highlights adjacency should be treated as review inventory.
Use structural labels until the official schedule feed lands.
governance_notes: College review required in MA, NY, OH, PA and TN in this demo source.
periods.one_off_brief: Build a March Madness one-off plan that separates unrestricted states from MA/NY/OH/PA/TN college-review states and keeps claims state-safe.
periods.insight: Demand rises, but the governance layer is the point: college restrictions shape where and how the spend can land.

periods.label: NBA Finals
channel_actions: Use CTV/YouTube for reach, Paid Search for intent capture and CRM/app prompts for existing customers.
Avoid treating Finals heat as football-scale demand.
inventory_notes: Primetime basketball inventory can be tested as a controlled video pulse.
governance_notes: Professional sports moment; normal state product eligibility applies.
periods.one_off_brief: Draft an NBA Finals video-led pulse for Sportsbook with CTV/YouTube support and Paid Search capture.
periods.insight: NBA Finals gives a compact primetime video window after the football peak fades.

periods.label: MLB Opening
channel_actions: Use paid search and app store capture for baseball intent.
Keep broader video spend subordinated to March Madness unless evidence says otherwise.
inventory_notes: Opening Day is a short window; use lightweight copy refreshes rather than full campaign rebuilds.
governance_notes: Professional sports moment; normal state product eligibility applies.
periods.one_off_brief: Create a compact MLB Opening intent-capture pulse for Sportsbook around Paid Search and App Store.
periods.insight: MLB Opening adds useful texture inside March, but it should not overwhelm March Madness governance planning.

periods.label: Masters and Derby
channel_actions: Use audience targeting and affiliates rather than broad national TV.
Test creator/contextual placements if compliant inventory is available.
inventory_notes: Inventory is event-specific; keep scale expectations modest.
governance_notes: Check racing availability and state claims before any horse-racing message.
periods.one_off_brief: Draft a targeted spring tentpole pulse around Masters and Derby audiences with modest paid-social/video support.
periods.insight: Spring niche tentpoles are better as audience-specific pulses than national scale moments.

periods.label: Summer trough
channel_actions: Lean into CRM, Organic Search and App Store hygiene.
Avoid forcing football-scale reach spend into a low-intensity month.
inventory_notes: Use the trough for testing and clean measurement rather than big-reach buys.
governance_notes: No special college badge; normal product eligibility applies.
periods.one_off_brief: Create a July efficiency plan focused on CRM, Organic Search and App Store rather than broad reach.
periods.insight: The cold story matters: lower heat is the window for owned, organic and efficiency work.
